body:
## Pull request overview

This PR restructures ROADMAP.md to reflect a shift in active development focus. With Q1-Q3 foundation work and Console v1.0 complete, the Next Phase sections (N.1-N.5) are elevated from future planning to current active priorities. The change improves roadmap clarity by moving these items before Q4 and adding explicit priority tiers (P0/P1/P2) with rationale.

**Changes:**
- Promoted Next Phase section from after Q4 to before Q4, reflecting actual execution order
- Added P0/P1/P2 priority classifications with "Why P0/P1/P2" rationale blocks for each Next Phase item
- Replaced duplicated Designer phase details in Q2.8 with cross-references to the consolidated N.2 section
- Added cross-references from Q3 marketplace (3.5) and community (3.6) items to N.3/N.4
- Enhanced Annual Targets table with N.x milestone mappings per quarter
